patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: (Daughter) He spiked a high fever, he's burning up and shaking, and he's barely making sense — so weak he can't stand. He's been complaining his urine burns for days.
presentation.triageNote: 79-year-old male with several days of painful urination, now febrile with shaking chills, confusion, and weakness so severe he cannot stand. Heart rate is 128 and blood pressure is 84/50.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 1 is appropriate because hypotension with confusion and severe weakness from suspected infection requires immediate fluid resuscitation and other lifesaving sepsis treatment.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This older adult has urinary symptoms followed by fever, rigors, confusion, profound weakness, tachycardia, and shock-level hypotension.
clinical.acuityReason: Blood pressure 84/50 with altered mental status indicates impaired perfusion requiring immediate resuscitation rather than delayed diagnostic sorting.
expectedResources: Immediate IV access and significant fluid resuscitation
Blood cultures, lactate, CBC, metabolic and urine testing
teachingPoints: Sepsis severity is reflected in perfusion and mental status, not fever alone.
Cultures should be obtained promptly when feasible, but antibiotics and resuscitation must not be delayed.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Immediate resuscitation, antibiotics, source assessment, and vasopressor support would require intensive monitored admission.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: 79-year-old man, flushed and sweaty, looks very ill
aiImageGeneration.pose: slumped, being propped up, barely holding his head up
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 79-year-old man, flushed and sweaty and clearly very ill, slumped on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: slumped and propped up, barely holding his head up. Expression: glassy, exhausted, and unwell. Clearly visible: a flushed sweaty face and a weak, slumped posture. No text, no logos.
